name: house-rules
description: Deterministic guardrails and skills that prevent recurring user-correction patterns. Sister plugin to house-style.

interface.shortDescription: Behavioral guardrails distilled from past corrections.
interface.longDescription: Distills recurring user-correction patterns from prior sessions into reusable skills (and Claude Code hooks). Covers commit hygiene, scope discipline, reference-grounded implementation, UI-change verification, analysis-vs-implementation mode, and test coverage discipline.
defaultPrompt: Apply house-rules guardrails to my current task.
Did I just violate a recurring correction pattern?
What scope am I committing to before I touch code?
